scope: Minimal consumed shapes for optional services whose complete record definitions are outside the integrated record inventory. The contracts preserve local callers and references without claiming an implementation of the optional service.

capabilities: Resolve the provider-specific payment initiation behavior.
Validate payment currency and amount according to provider settings.
Create a payment session or payment resource address for a payment request.
Return an explicit failure when the provider cannot create a session.
payment_gateway.local_accounting_rule: A payment gateway account links the provider identity to a company ledger account. Its currency is taken from that ledger account. Selecting a default clears the default flag on other gateway accounts for the same company; when no other default exists the current account becomes default.
payment_gateway.availability_rule: Optional provider-package absence must be reported by the payment boundary when that provider capability is invoked.

required_fields.status: loan business status; closed loans are excluded

inputs: salary ending date used as value date

required_fields.identity: stable product identity carried through payroll deduction and repayment

loan_product.scope: Payroll preserves the product identity. Product pricing, interest calculation policy, and full lending lifecycle are owned by the optional loan service.

loan_repayment.create_rule: Save and post the repayment, then retain the returned repayment identity on the salary loan row.
loan_repayment.cancel_rule: When reversing the salary loan consequence, invoke cancellation of the related repayment according to the payroll cancellation order.
